# AiLunaPro

> AiLunaPro is an AI governance preparation platform: estimate-only AI readiness
> audits, an AI registry, Shadow AI signals, and indicative EU AI Act guidance.

## Public pages

- [Audit Express](https://audit.ailunapro.com/audit-express): Free, estimate-only AI readiness snapshot — automatable tasks, Shadow AI signals, an indicative EU AI Act level, and a rough ROI. No account required.
- [Global AI regulation landscape](https://audit.ailunapro.com/eu-ai-act/): Plain-language, non-exhaustive overview of AI regulation worldwide (EU AI Act plus UK, US, Canada, Brazil, China, Japan, South Korea, India, Singapore, Australia/NZ and more) and how AiLunaPro helps you prepare. Informational only, not legal advice.
- [FAQ](https://audit.ailunapro.com/faq/): Common questions about AiLunaPro — what it is, accounts, how readiness estimates work, data security, and support.
- [Shadow AI](https://audit.ailunapro.com/shadow-ai/): What Shadow AI is, why it matters, common signs, and practical governance hygiene to reduce it — plus how AiLunaPro helps. Informational only, not legal advice.
- [Our methodology](https://audit.ailunapro.com/methodologie/): How AiLunaPro estimates AI readiness — a transparent, rule-based, deterministic five-step method. Informational only, not legal advice.
- [Pricing](https://audit.ailunapro.com/pricing/): Plans (Free, Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with features; live multi-currency prices are shown in the app at checkout.
- [For SMEs](https://audit.ailunapro.com/use-cases/pme/): How small and medium businesses use AiLunaPro to inventory AI, surface Shadow AI, and prepare for governance.
- [For independent professionals](https://audit.ailunapro.com/use-cases/independant/): Lightweight AI governance preparation for freelancers and solo professionals.

## Disclaimer

Preparation support, NOT a compliance certification, attestation, or legal advice.
